connector.name: Memory Vault
connector.registryDescription: Local-first AI memory layer with hybrid search. Postgres + pgvector. Self-hosted, MIT.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image memory-vault-mcp:1.0.6. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mihaibuilds account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DB_HOST
env.description: Hostname of the Postgres+pgvector instance Memory Vault connects to (e.g. 'host.docker.internal' when Postgres runs on the host, 'localhost' when running natively, or the service name when both run in compose)

env.name: DB_USER
env.description: Postgres user with read/write access to the memory vault database
